newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish 1996 sugar output seen hitting record.
newsitem.headline: Polish 1996 sugar output seen hitting record.

text.p: Polish sugar production this year is expected to reach a record level of over 2.1 million tonnes, PAP news agency said on Saturday.
"Sugar production this year will be a record high and will exceed 2.1 million tonnes," PAP quoted Artur Suger, the head of the Polish Sugar Council, as saying.
"High sugarbeet crops and increased sugar content justify such a forecast," he added.
Last month the Central Statistical Office (GUS) predicted this year's sugarbeet output to rise to between 16.50 million and 17.30 million tonnes from last year's 13.31 million.
Sugar output was estimated at about two million tonnes, up from 1.58 million last year.
An October 7 beet test showed the average sugar content rose to 16.54 percent from 15.98 percent a year ago.
Sugar told PAP that this year's sugar campaign was more than halfway through with almost nine million tonnes of beets already processed and 550,000 tonnes of sugar produced.
